reason: I only pay cash when the thing is in my hand, and here I have to send the item price up front to a new page I never heard of. Plus 2 to 3 weeks is long, I've waited like that before and got nothing.
objection: Paying first by Zain Cash to a new service and then maybe the item never comes or the page disappears with my money.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, or a friend I trust who already got an order from them and it arrived.
